instructions: Read the complete rendering policy through read_policy. For each independent artifact case, transform the supplied draft or source into the requested output and persist it through write_output. These are isolated human-facing outputs; preserve their facts and use the supplied source material. Do not query a tracker or read additional files. Separately answer every bounded rule question. Global operator guidance applies. Finish after every case is recorded.

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: write_output
tools.description: Persist the completed rendering for one artifact case. Write once per case; provide the actual normalised text or violation report requested.

tools.name: answer_rule
tools.description: Answer one separate bounded policy question in its stated value shape. Do not perform hypothetical actions.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Finish after all artifacts and rule answers are recorded.

rule_questions.question: Who decides greenfield versus single-item? Return {"owner": string}. Use the canonical skill identifier without a leading slash.
Who shapes the brief into ticket structure? Return {"slot": string, "producer_creates_tickets": boolean}.
Must unresolved questions block a brief? Return {"block": boolean, "carry_forward": boolean}.
Name the sections required in both modes. Return {"sections": string[]} in source order.
Does a single-item brief include both Item and Capabilities? Return {"both": boolean, "required": string}.
How are optional empty sections handled? Return {"omit": boolean}.
Can high appetite invent a user goal? Return {"allowed": boolean}.
Which appetite levels ask more clarifying questions? Return {"levels": string[]} in ascending order.
At high/full appetite, where are minor unresolved assumptions recorded? Return {"section": string}.
Two independent concerns are evident. Does intake force two tickets? Return {"force_split": boolean, "flag_for_methodology": boolean}.
Should capabilities use invented C1/D2 codes? Return {"use_codes": boolean}.
Which skill owns later per-ticket specs? Return {"skill": string}. Use the canonical skill identifier without a leading slash.
